verdict.rationale: monday.com documents native agents that users build inside the product by describing a workflow in their own words (monday-docs-14, monday-docs-13). Users can then delegate work to them like teammates: assign them items, message them in updates, or @mention them, and the agents return replies, statuses and follow-ups (monday-docs-11, monday-docs-19). Example delegated tasks include scheduled status reports, summarizing calls, extracting action items and scoring deals, and admins can audit every action an agent takes (monday-docs-21, monday-docs-23, monday-docs-32, monday-docs-10). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works reliably, and in-depth docs beyond marketing-level claims (limits, task types, failure handling).
